seo.title: About Niraum Metals
seo.description: Niraum Metals, established in 2026 in Lalitpur, is developing the Katujpani iron deposit in Makawanpur. Meet our founder and our technical partner.

hero.title: Developing Nepal's iron ore, responsibly.
hero.intro: Established in 2026 in Lalitpur-13, Nepal. We are taking the Katujpani iron deposit from study to supply.

story.title: Engineering first. Promises second.
story.p1: Niraum Metals was established in 2026 to develop the Katujpani iron deposit in Makawanpur District and supply hematite ore to Nepal’s cement and metals industry.
story.p2: We work with engineers, geologists and technical specialists, publish our assay data with its source, and never describe our ore beyond what the numbers show.

values.title: What guides every decision.
values.missionBody: Develop Nepal's iron ore resources responsibly and supply industry with ore it can trust.
values.safetyBody: PPE, training and the right to stop unsafe work.
values.integrityBody: Real numbers, with their source, under every claim.
values.communityBody: Local hiring and early, honest consultation.
values.longTermBody: Topsoil kept, land restored, partnerships built to last.

partner.title: Studies by Shubharambha Mining and Engineering Services.
partner.body: The mine scheme, field sampling and assay reporting for Katujpani were prepared by Shubharambha Mining and Engineering Services Pvt. Ltd., Tarkeshwor-07, Kathmandu, under Department of Mines and Geology (DMG) guidelines.
